doc: Smoothstep on a float32 x (the python floats a = -1.6 and b = 0 stay weak, so the whole chain is float32), x from -3 to 3. Tolerance is the golden float32 default. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 1.1e-7; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 2.4e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 23x the larger of the two spreads.
